title: マイルCS南部杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So, I've been thinking that running both the turf and dirt Mile Championships is the perfect move for a true all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which is why I'm miles from home, visiting Morioka! Get it? Miles. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And would you believe my luck? I run into Morioka's very own Yukino! She's offered me her precious support, so now I've gotta put on a good show for her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Will I manage to gain victory and chat with the locals without suffering any communication barriers?! Find out next time! ☆
